note: --name sets the session title only, per documented precedence (--name → /rename → last meaningful message → myhost-graceful-unicorn). It is not part of the environment registration payload and has no effect on the picker's environment label. /rename renames a session within an environment, not the environment. Restart re-mints env id but the same derived label.
log: [name] --name sets the session title only, not the environment label; /rename stays inside the env
